newsitem.title: UKRAINE: German firm, Ukraine capital city sign hotel deal.
newsitem.headline: German firm, Ukraine capital city sign hotel deal.

text.p: Germany's Hochtief AG and Ukraine's capital city have signed a contract for construction of a $75 million, five-star hotel, a statement from the Kiev City State Administration said on Friday.

"Investments are expected to come from the German side, from the International Finance Corporation (IFC) and from several foreign investment funds," the statement said, adding that Hochtief would construct the downtown Kiev hotel.
It did not say when the project would be completed.
Several hotel projects have been announced in Kiev, a city of three million people which lacks a Western-style hotel almost six years after Ukraine won independence from the Soviet Union.
The IFC is the private investment arm of the World Bank.
